tagline.en: README images from one URL: banners, badges, icons and GitHub stats cards.
tagline.zh-Hant: 一個網址生成 README 圖像：橫幅、徽章、圖示及 GitHub 統計卡。

summary.en: Mark needs no account or personal access token. It renders images from your URL and reads public upstream data for live cards and badges. The studio uses no cookies, browser storage or analytics; requests still pass through our servers and content delivery network.
summary.zh-Hant: Mark 無需帳戶或個人存取權杖。它根據你的網址產生圖像，並讀取公開的上游資料以製作即時統計卡和徽章。編輯器不使用 Cookie、瀏覽器儲存或分析工具；請求仍會經過我們的伺服器和內容傳遞網絡。

body.en: When a browser or image proxy requests an image, our infrastructure receives the requested URL and technical request data, such as the IP address and HTTP headers. Mark logs request details, including the URL, for service operations. It uses the client IP address (an IPv6 /64 prefix for IPv6 clients) to limit upstream requests.
body.zh-Hant: 當瀏覽器或圖像代理請求圖像時，我們的基礎設施會收到請求網址及技術資料，例如 IP 位址和 HTTP 標頭。Mark 會記錄包含網址的請求資料以維持服務運作，並使用用戶端 IP 位址（IPv6 用戶端則使用 /64 網段）限制上游請求。

body.en: Text, usernames, repository names, package names and endpoint URLs you include are used to render the image. Images and their URLs can be public and cached by browsers, proxies and CDNs. Do not put secrets or private information in an image URL.
body.zh-Hant: 你提供的文字、使用者名稱、儲存庫名稱、套件名稱及端點網址會用於產生圖像。圖像及其網址可能公開，並由瀏覽器、代理和 CDN 快取。請勿在圖像網址中放入秘密或私人資料。

body.en: Live cards and badges request public data from GitHub, npm, pub.dev, Packagist, Bundlephobia, the Chrome Web Store, PyPI, crates.io and Docker Hub. Endpoint badges fetch the public HTTPS JSON endpoint named in your URL. The relevant service receives the identifiers needed for that request from Mark's server; you do not supply a personal access token.
body.zh-Hant: 即時統計卡和徽章會向 GitHub、npm、pub.dev、Packagist、Bundlephobia、Chrome 線上應用程式商店、PyPI、crates.io 和 Docker Hub 請求公開資料。端點徽章會讀取你在網址中指定的公開 HTTPS JSON 端點。相關服務會從 Mark 伺服器收到完成請求所需的識別資料；你無需提供個人存取權杖。

body.en: We process these data to deliver and cache images, keep the service available and limit abuse. The lawful basis is our legitimate interests in operating a free public image service (UK GDPR Article 6(1)(f)).
body.zh-Hant: 我們處理這些資料以提供及快取圖像、維持服務可用性並限制濫用。法律依據是我們營運免費公開圖像服務的合法利益（英國 GDPR 第 6(1)(f) 條）。

body.en: Our hosting infrastructure and Cloudflare content delivery network process requests to serve Mark. Cloudflare operates globally, so request data may be processed outside the UK under the safeguards required by UK law. We do not sell personal data or use it for advertising.
body.zh-Hant: 我們的託管基礎設施及 Cloudflare 內容傳遞網絡會處理請求以提供 Mark 服務。Cloudflare 在全球營運，因此請求資料可能在英國境外處理，並採用英國法律要求的保障措施。我們不出售個人資料，也不將其用於廣告。

body.en: Mark keeps bounded in-memory caches of live upstream data. Fresh lifetimes depend on the data, from five minutes for workflow status to 24 hours for star history; stale data may be served on upstream failure for up to 14 days. Static images have public browser and CDN cache headers of up to one year. Live image responses have browser cache headers of 30 minutes and shared-cache headers of four hours, with stale-on-error caching of up to seven days. Copies outside Mark may persist independently.
body.zh-Hant: Mark 使用容量有限的記憶體快取儲存即時上游資料。新鮮資料的有效期因資料而異，從工作流程狀態的五分鐘至星標歷史的 24 小時不等；上游故障時，舊資料可繼續提供最多 14 天。靜態圖像的公開瀏覽器及 CDN 快取標頭最長為一年。即時圖像回應的瀏覽器快取標頭為 30 分鐘，共享快取標頭為四小時，錯誤時的舊快取最長為七天。Mark 以外的副本可能獨立保留。

body.en: Operational request logs are used for running the service and investigating failures or abuse. This notice does not promise a fixed log-deletion interval. Mark has no user account or saved-image database to delete.
body.zh-Hant: 營運請求記錄用於維持服務及調查故障或濫用。本通知不承諾固定的記錄刪除期限。Mark 沒有可供刪除的使用者帳戶或已儲存圖像資料庫。

body.en: For a privacy request, email hi@sylphx.com with the image URL and enough context to identify the request, without sending secrets. Since Mark has no accounts, an account name alone cannot locate request data. We may update this notice; the date above identifies this version.
body.zh-Hant: 如有私隱查詢，請電郵至 hi@sylphx.com，提供圖像網址及足以識別請求的背景資料，請勿傳送秘密。由於 Mark 沒有帳戶，單憑帳戶名稱無法找到請求資料。我們可能更新本通知；上方日期標示此版本。

q.en: Do I need an account, payment or a token?
q.zh-Hant: 我需要帳戶、付款或權杖嗎？

a.en: No. Mark is free and needs no sign-up or personal access token. Open https://mark.sylphx.com, create an image URL and embed it in your README or site.
a.zh-Hant: 不需要。Mark 免費，無需註冊或個人存取權杖。開啟 https://mark.sylphx.com，建立圖像網址並嵌入 README 或網站即可。

q.en: Can I reuse an existing README image URL?
q.zh-Hant: 我可以沿用現有的 README 圖像網址嗎？

a.en: For supported Shields, capsule-render, skill-icons, readme-typing-svg and GitHub card URL formats, keep the path and query and change the host to mark.sylphx.com. See https://mark.sylphx.com/docs for supported routes. Unimplemented badge routes return an unsupported badge, not live data.
a.zh-Hant: 對於支援的 Shields、capsule-render、skill-icons、readme-typing-svg 及 GitHub 統計卡網址格式，保留路徑和查詢參數，將主機改為 mark.sylphx.com。支援的路徑見 https://mark.sylphx.com/docs。尚未實作的徽章路徑會傳回 unsupported 徽章，而非即時資料。

q.en: Why is a live card stale or temporarily unavailable?
q.zh-Hant: 為何即時統計卡的資料過時或暫時無法使用？

a.en: Live data is cached. If an upstream is slow, unavailable or rate-limited, Mark can serve stale data; without a usable cache it renders a fallback image. Mark reads public data, not private repositories through your personal token.
a.zh-Hant: 即時資料會被快取。當上游速度慢、無法使用或受到流量限制時，Mark 可提供舊資料；沒有可用快取時則產生備用圖像。Mark 讀取公開資料，不會使用你的個人權杖讀取私人儲存庫。

q.en: How do I change or remove an image?

a.en: Edit the URL parameters to create a new image, or remove the embed from the README or site you control. Mark does not save images in an account. Browsers, image proxies and CDNs may retain old copies; removing an embed does not purge their caches.
a.zh-Hant: 修改網址參數以建立新圖像，或從你管理的 README 或網站移除嵌入內容。Mark 不會在帳戶中儲存圖像。瀏覽器、圖像代理和 CDN 可能保留舊副本；移除嵌入內容不會清除它們的快取。

q.en: How do I report a problem?

a.en: Email hi@sylphx.com with the image URL, where it appears, what you expected and what happened. Do not send access tokens or other secrets. Documentation is at https://mark.sylphx.com/docs and source code is at https://github.com/SylphxAI/readme-mark.
a.zh-Hant: 請電郵至 hi@sylphx.com，提供圖像網址、出現位置、預期結果及實際情況。請勿傳送存取權杖或其他秘密。文件位於 https://mark.sylphx.com/docs，原始碼位於 https://github.com/SylphxAI/readme-mark。
